title: Hypotension Prediction Index in Postoperative Surgical Patients
official: Hypotension Prediction Index in Postoperative Surgical Patients in the Post-anesthetic Recovery Room - a Feasibility Study
summary: PACU-HPI study evaluates the use of a hemodynamic monitor in the post-anesthetic recovery room on patients undergoing colorectal, hepatobiliary, and vascular surgery, to determine the feasibility of recruiting this surgical population.

interventions.name: Device: HemoSphere monitor and Acumen IQ sensor.

sponsor: Sir Mortimer B. Davis - Jewish General Hospital
